column1: # matrix.tsv -- the host x target x toolchain matrix (harness-tests-full-cross-build-matrix-req,
# harness-target-matrix-v2-req). Read by matrix.sh. Tab-separated; '#' starts a comment.
#  kind    native  the unit suite, run inside <build> with <toolchain>
#          cross   Hello built in <build> for <target> (llvm; gcc never cross-compiles),
#  build   a platform id from platforms.mk: where the compiler runs
#  exec    a platform id to run the result on, or  blocked:<reason>  /  none:<reason>
#          (cross-test-universal-coverage: an impossible cell is listed with its reason)
# cell id                          kind    build             target           toolchain  exec
